🔥 Gas standing charges are being scrapped — sounds great, right?

Not so fast. ⚠️ The cost moves into the price per unit. MoneySavingExpert estimates the average gas rate could rise from 7.97p to 9.11p/kWh, and Martin Lewis reckons around 40% of people would pay MORE — including many pensioners who are home all day.

Plus the £100 payment only goes to council tax bands A–D. 💷

Don’t shuffle bills around — cut them. 👉 https://lukeparker.co.uk/articles/healey-gas-standing-charge-100-payment-who-really-pays-november-2026.html
